Name: Video Player
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[b]Update! Thanks to help from Platonymous, this mod can now play WMV files directly! [/b]

This mod plays compatible [b] WMV [/b]files only. WMV video files should be placed in the mod's [b]assets [/b]folder.

Details on how to convert videos into compatible WMV format are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/468]here[/url].

To open the video player, press NumPad 8.

To pause the video player, press NumPad 2.

To rewind the video to the beginning, press the pause key when paused.

To move to the next video file, press NumPad 6.

To move to the previous video file, press NumPad 4.

To move the video player around the screen, hold down CTRL and press the above hotkeys.

Clicking on the video screen toggles pause/play.

Hovering over the screen causes controls to appear for stop and last/next track;

To resize the player, edit the config.json file.

To make the video play on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url], set that variable to true in the config.json file.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], does not use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
